rv.q: This production is very Fein indeed.
This production has none of the broadness or festive spirit of a Christmas show or panto, but the wonder and magic of both.

The honour now falls to another American director, Olivier Award-winner Jordan Fein, whose beautiful production for the Bridge Theatre makes a classy alternative to panto yet is richly detailed enough long to outlive the festive season.
It's a great production of a terrific show.
